description: Historic city gate with a distinctive character
longDescription: The 'Schwarzes Tor' was an important entrance to the historic town. The place marks the transition between the old urban structure and today's usage. On site, pay attention to masonry, proportions and the routing of paths around the gate — many traces of the town's history can be discovered here.
rewardHint: Visit all 4 rooms for your reward!
zeitreiseSubtitle: Move your phone and choose a room.
zeitreiseStartDescription: Move your phone to explore the house and choose a room.
introKueche: After working in the fields, the family needs to be fed. The kitchen is the smoky, sooty heart of the house, where an open hearth and simple wood stoves serve as cooking places. Everything is prepared by hand.
introWohnraum: In the evening, when the work is done, the family gathers together.
introScheune: The day starts early. The family's nutrition depends directly on the harvest.
introArbeitsstube: Clothing and textiles are not bought but laboriously made by hand. Flax and wool must be processed. This work is very time-consuming and is often done during the winter months.
introTitleArbeitsstube: History of the Work Room / Weaving Chamber
